milestone: Package 18: spec-doc-check shipped; kit at 18 packages, 142 tests

package.name: dsh-spec-doc-check
package.decides: spec structure: problem stated, checkable acceptance criteria, explicit out-of-scope, no wish-as-criterion
package.distinct_rule: the vague-criterion rule is not a word blacklist — a criterion carrying a number, threshold, or named observable passes even when it also contains 良好; the rule fires only when the wish is all there is, which is what keeps it from punishing honest prose

design_note: the out-of-scope requirement is the second rule worth naming: a spec without edges expands at review, and requiring the boundary explicitly is cheaper than discovering it during implementation
quality_bar: 142 tests across the kit (10 new), audit 18/18 clean, site 20 pages, npm 0.1.0 live
